recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation, low-quality ingredients, or lack of attention to detail in the kitchen.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen quality control program, including daily taste tests, ingredient freshness checks, and mandatory retraining for all kitchen staff on standard recipes and presentation.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly improved food consistency and taste, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat visits.

recommendations.issue: Insufficient staff training, low staff morale, or understaffing leading to stress.
recommendations.action: Launch a mandatory customer service training program focusing on empathy, active listening, and problem-solving. Simultaneously, review staffing levels during peak hours and implement team-building activities to boost morale.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more positive and helpful service experience for customers, reducing negative staff-related reviews and improving overall atmosphere.

recommendations.issue: Menu prices not aligning with perceived food quality or portion sizes, or competitive pricing issues.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis and a value perception study. Consider adjusting portion sizes, enhancing presentation, or introducing value-oriented specials to justify current prices or re-evaluate menu pricing strategy.
recommendations.expected_impact: Customers will perceive better value for money, reducing complaints about high prices and potentially increasing order frequency.

recommendations.issue: Diverse operational shortcomings or specific unaddressed customer needs.
recommendations.action: Implement a structured customer feedback system (e.g., digital surveys, comment cards) to identify specific, recurring 'other' issues. Conduct a full operational audit to uncover hidden inefficiencies or service gaps.
recommendations.expected_impact: Pinpoint and address previously unclassified issues, leading to a more refined and satisfying overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: Inefficient kitchen operations, inadequate staffing during peak hours, or poor table management.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour traffic and kitchen workflow. Implement a new table management system, cross-train front-of-house staff, and optimize kitchen station assignments to reduce order processing and delivery times.
recommendations.expected_impact: Shorter wait times for seating, ordering, and food delivery, improving customer flow and reducing frustration.

recommendations.issue: Outdated decor, poor lighting, noise levels, or lack of maintenance in the dining area.
recommendations.action: Allocate budget for minor aesthetic upgrades (e.g., fresh paint, updated lighting fixtures, new artwork). Invest in sound-dampening solutions (e.g., acoustic panels) and establish a weekly maintenance checklist for the dining area.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more inviting, comfortable, and modern dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient cleaning staff, or lack of regular maintenance checks.
recommendations.action: Develop and enforce a detailed daily and weekly cleaning checklist for all areas (dining, restrooms, kitchen). Conduct regular spot checks by management and provide refresher training on hygiene standards for all staff.
recommendations.expected_impact: A visibly cleaner and more hygienic establishment, boosting customer confidence and satisfaction.
